name: api_incidents_select_option
_description: PLAN V1.0 Bloque 9 - POST /api/v1/incidents/select-option. Arquitecto elige opcion 0|1 + action='communicate'|'reject'. Si communicate: UPDATE incidents (selected_option_index, cost_delta, time_delta, status=communicated), envia Gmail al cliente con tabla comparativa + link decision publica.

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok
)
SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.tenant_id, i.description, i.location, i.severity,
       i.causa_probable, i.options, i.client_communication_draft, i.status,
       p.name AS project_name, p.location_city, p.location_address,
       c.name AS client_name, c.email AS client_email
FROM project_incidents i
JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id, ctx
WHERE i.id = $4::uuid
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE project_incidents SET
  selected_option_index=$2::int,
  cost_delta_eur=$3::numeric,
  time_delta_days=$4::int,
  client_communication_draft=$5,
  status='communicated',
  client_communication_sent_at=now()
WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status IN ('proposed','detected')
RETURNING id, status, selected_option_index, cost_delta_eur, time_delta_days;
